instruction: Create a reminder "Easter egg" and then immediately mark it as completed.
evaluator: osascript -e 'tell application "Reminders" to get the name of every reminder whose completed is true' | grep -q "Easter egg" >/dev/null && echo "True" || echo "False"
osascript -e 'tell application "Reminders" to get the name of every reminder' | grep -q "Easter egg" >/dev/null && echo "True" || echo "False"
